title: Sperm Counts Have Fallen More Than 50% Since 1973
hook: Men are losing their sperm, and the drop is getting faster.
closing: The decline now affects both concentration and total output, raising the stakes for future families.
question: Did you know sperm counts dropped?

segments.say: In 1973, the average count was 101. By 2018 it was under half that, establishing the long decline.
Since 2000, counts fall 2.6% a year, more than double the old pace. The same decline is accelerating.
That acceleration reaches the whole sample: total sperm count fell 62%, not just the concentration.
